lines.zh: 退三步，再退三步，射程才够。
lines.en: Three steps back, then three more; my range needs room.

lines.zh: 绕着糖果树走，找一条干净的射线。
lines.en: Circling the candy tree to find a clean firing line.

lines.zh: 踩碎地上的糖壳，声音太响了。
lines.en: The sugar crust cracks underfoot, far too loud.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，我的准头需要距离。
lines.en: Do not come closer; my aim needs distance.

lines.zh: 糖浆黏住脚，每一步都拖着丝。
lines.en: Syrup glues my feet; every step pulls a thread.

lines.zh: 沿河岸走，那里没有遮挡。
lines.en: I walk the riverbank where nothing blocks the shot.

lines.zh: 樱桃外壳沉，走久了发烫。
lines.en: This cherry shell is heavy and warms as I walk.

lines.zh: 拐过糖果山，视野就开阔了。
lines.en: Past the candy hill the view opens wide.

lines.zh: 我在数退路，一步都不能少。
lines.en: I am counting my retreat steps, none to spare.

lines.zh: 软糖地面会陷，绕着走。
lines.en: The gummy ground sinks; I walk around it.

lines.zh: 后退不代表怕，只是战术。
lines.en: Falling back is not fear, only tactics.

lines.zh: 身后那条直线，我记住了。
lines.en: That straight line behind me is memorized.

lines.zh: 外壳红得发亮，像颗熟透的樱桃。
lines.en: My shell shines red like an overripe cherry.

lines.zh: 凑近闻闻，半点樱桃味都没有。
lines.en: Lean in and smell: not a trace of cherry.

lines.zh: 酸味从缝里渗出来，我不喜欢。
lines.en: Sourness seeps through my seams; I dislike it.

lines.zh: 魔法弹在体内转，像被摇过的汽水。
lines.en: Magic bolts churn in me like shaken soda.

lines.zh: 有人以为我是水果，真可笑。
lines.en: Some take me for fruit; how laughable.

lines.zh: 糖霜落在壳上，我懒得擦。
lines.en: Frosting collects on my shell; I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 我在等一个背对我的身影。
lines.en: I am waiting for a back turned my way.

lines.zh: 数一数还剩几发，够用就好。
lines.en: Counting my remaining bolts; enough will do.

lines.zh: 这颗樱桃不甜，只会炸开。
lines.en: This cherry is not sweet; it only blossoms into fire.

lines.zh: 糖做的世界，血腥味却真实。
lines.en: A world of sugar, yet the blood smells real.

lines.zh: 我舔了舔裂缝，酸得牙根发麻。
lines.en: I lick a crack; the sourness numbs my jaw.

lines.zh: 安静，正好校一校准星。
lines.en: Quiet now, perfect for tuning my sights.

lines.zh: 远处的糖果屋在反光，晃眼。
lines.en: The candy house glare hurts my eyes.

lines.zh: 樱桃核里装的都是火药。
lines.en: Inside this cherry pit there is only gunpowder.

lines.zh: 我把准星挪到一片阴影上。
lines.en: I shift my aim onto a patch of shadow.

lines.zh: 糖果做的风，吹不动我。
lines.en: The candy wind can't move me.

lines.zh: 你又靠近了，退到我射程外。
lines.en: You closed in again; get beyond my range.

lines.zh: 那双眼睛在算什么距离？
lines.en: Those eyes are measuring distance, are they not?

lines.zh: 站住别动，我好瞄准。
lines.en: Stand still; it makes my aiming easier.

lines.zh: 你的靴子上沾着酸糖果。
lines.en: There is sour candy smeared on your boots.

lines.zh: 看着我做什么，我不是甜点。
lines.en: Why stare? I am not a dessert.

lines.zh: 再走近一步，我就先开火。
lines.en: One more step and I fire first.

lines.zh: 你的影子挡住了我的射线。
lines.en: Your shadow is blocking my firing line.

lines.zh: 我认得那副弓，射程不如我。
lines.en: I know that bow; its range is shorter than mine.

lines.zh: 别伸手，樱桃壳会咬人。
lines.en: Do not reach out; the cherry shell bites.

lines.zh: 你把盾举那么高，我换角度。
lines.en: Shield that high? I will change my angle.

lines.zh: 眼神别躲，我讨厌猜。
lines.en: Do not dodge my eyes; I hate guessing.

lines.zh: 你身上的糖味，比我甜。
lines.en: The sugar on you smells sweeter than me.

lines.zh: 看你的指节，比看脸有用。
lines.en: Reading your knuckles tells me more than your face.

lines.zh: 点头也没用，我照打不误。
lines.en: Nodding will not help; I still shoot.

lines.zh: 壳裂了，魔法在往外漏。
lines.en: The shell cracked; magic is leaking out.

lines.zh: 这一下够酸，比你手里的糖酸。
lines.en: That hit is sourer than your candy.

lines.zh: 别打壳，打哪儿都疼。
lines.en: Not the shell; everywhere hurts.

lines.zh: 我退，不是认输，是换位置。
lines.en: I retreat, not surrender: a new position.

lines.zh: 糖霜掉了，露出里面的火药。
lines.en: The frosting is gone; gunpowder shows beneath.

lines.zh: 你会后悔打中一颗樱桃。
lines.en: You will regret hitting a cherry.

lines.zh: 碎了半边，还能再射三发。
lines.en: Half shattered, still three bolts left.

lines.zh: 疼得我准星都在抖。
lines.en: The pain makes my sights tremble.

lines.zh: 记住，是你要先动手的。
lines.en: Remember, you struck first.

lines.zh: 樱桃也会流血，别装惊讶。
lines.en: Cherries bleed too; do not look surprised.

lines.zh: 酸糖果？扔过来，我看看。
lines.en: Sour candy? Toss it here so I can look.

lines.zh: 你手里那包东西，颜色对。
lines.en: That packet in your hand has the right color.

lines.zh: 别晃，糖纸声让我分心。
lines.en: Stop rustling; the wrapper noise distracts me.

lines.zh: 我不吃甜的，酸的可以考虑。
lines.en: I do not eat sweet things; sour is negotiable.

lines.zh: 一颗换一次不瞄准，成交？
lines.en: One candy for one missed shot, deal?

lines.zh: 糖渣掉地上了，捡起来。
lines.en: You dropped crumbs; pick them up.

lines.zh: 这味道比樱桃更像樱桃。
lines.en: That smell is more cherry than a cherry.

lines.zh: 你把袋子打开，我靠近点。
lines.en: Open the bag and I will come closer.

lines.zh: 别以为几颗糖就能收买我。
lines.en: Do not think a few candies buy me.

lines.zh: 再来一颗，我还没尝出来。
lines.en: Another one; I have not tasted it yet.

lines.zh: 你撞过来，肩胛骨硌得我疼。
lines.en: You crashed into me; your shoulder blade stings.

lines.zh: 退开，壳裂了会漏魔法。
lines.en: Back off; a cracked shell leaks magic.

lines.zh: 别用身体量我的射程。
lines.en: Do not measure my range with your body.

lines.zh: 这一下撞得我准星偏了。
lines.en: That knock threw my sights off.

lines.zh: 糖壳凹进去一块，赔吗？
lines.en: A dent in my sugar shell; will you pay?

lines.zh: 挤什么，路那么宽。
lines.en: Why shove? The path is wide.

lines.zh: 你再顶，我就贴着脸开火。
lines.en: Push again and I fire against your face.

lines.zh: 碰撞声在糖果山谷里回荡。
lines.en: The knock echoes through the candy valley.

lines.zh: 离远点，我讨厌被蹭。
lines.en: Stay off me; I hate being rubbed.

lines.zh: 撞一次，我退一次，记着。
lines.en: One bump, one retreat; remember it.

lines.zh: 两颗樱桃并排，外壳碰着外壳。
lines.en: Two cherries side by side, shell against shell.

lines.zh: 我不甜，但愿意分你一半酸。
lines.en: I am not sweet, but I will share my sourness.

lines.zh: 等糖雨落下，我们再谈。
lines.en: When the sugar rain falls, we will talk.

lines.zh: 你的红比我深，像熟过了头。
lines.en: Your red runs deeper than mine, overripe.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，会一起引爆。
lines.en: Not too close, or we both go off.

lines.zh: 樱桃核要埋进软糖土里。
lines.en: The pits must be buried in gummy soil.

lines.zh: 我数着你的魔法弹，一发不差。
lines.en: I count your bolts; not one is missing.

lines.zh: 酸味混在一起，倒也不难闻。
lines.en: Our sourness mingles; it is not unpleasant.

lines.zh: 同一棵糖果树下，等你。
lines.en: Under the same candy tree, I wait for you.

lines.zh: 壳裂之前，先记住这个味道。
lines.en: Before the shells crack, remember this taste.

lines.zh: 这颗糖掉了，归我。
lines.en: This candy dropped; it is mine.

lines.zh: 弯腰捡东西，射程就没了。
lines.en: Bending to pick things costs me my range.

lines.zh: 糖纸别乱扔，我收着。
lines.en: Do not litter wrappers; I collect them.

lines.zh: 地上的酸糖果，一颗颗数清。
lines.en: Sour candies on the ground, counted one by one.

lines.zh: 捡起来才发现是石头做的。
lines.en: Picked it up; it is only painted stone.

lines.zh: 谁掉的樱桃核？我留着。
lines.en: Whose cherry pit is this? I keep it.

lines.zh: 这点糖不够塞壳缝。
lines.en: This much sugar will not fill my shell seams.

lines.zh: 用爪子拨了拨，滚远了。
lines.en: I nudged it with a claw; it rolled away.

lines.zh: 低头的瞬间最危险，我知道。
lines.en: The moment I bow my head is the dangerous one.

lines.zh: 捡完就退，别在这停留。
lines.en: Pick it up and retreat; do not linger here.

lines.zh: 你的脚步进了我的射程。
lines.en: Your footsteps have entered my range.

lines.zh: 就你了，站得最直的那个。
lines.en: You, the one standing straightest.

lines.zh: 魔法弹上膛，先礼后兵。
lines.en: Bolt loaded; courtesy first, then force.

lines.zh: 别跑，跑起来我的准头更稳。
lines.en: Do not run; running steadies my aim.

lines.zh: 我看见你腰间的药水了。
lines.en: I see the potion at your belt.

lines.zh: 背对我的那一刻，就是现在。
lines.en: The moment you turned your back: now.

lines.zh: 隔着糖浆河，我照样打得到。
lines.en: Across the syrup river I still reach you.

lines.zh: 挑中你，就因为你没带盾。
lines.en: I picked you precisely because you brought no shield.

lines.zh: 樱桃红的准星落在你胸口。
lines.en: My cherry-red sight rests on your chest.

lines.zh: 别指望躲进糖果丛。
lines.en: Do not hope to hide in the candy bushes.

lines.zh: 这一发是警告，下一发不是。
lines.en: This shot is a warning; the next is not.

lines.zh: 锁定，退路我已经算好。
lines.en: Locked on, and my retreat is already planned.

lines.zh: 左三步，右两步，你躲不干净。
lines.en: Three left, two right; you cannot dodge clean.

lines.zh: 魔法弹在壳里发烫，快好了。
lines.en: The bolt heats inside my shell, nearly ready.

lines.zh: 你举盾的角度偏了半寸。
lines.en: Your shield angle is off by half an inch.

lines.zh: 我在等你踩上那块软糖。
lines.en: I wait for you to step on that gummy tile.

lines.zh: 呼吸别乱，我的准星跟着它。
lines.en: Steady your breath; my sight follows it.

lines.zh: 糖浆会拖慢你，我知道。
lines.en: The syrup will slow you; I know it.

lines.zh: 数到三，我就松手。
lines.en: On three, I let it go.

lines.zh: 你身后的墙会接住弹片。
lines.en: The wall behind you will catch the shards.

lines.zh: 别低头看脚，抬头看我。
lines.en: Do not look at your feet; look at me.

lines.zh: 这个距离，我闭眼都能中。
lines.en: At this distance I could hit with eyes shut.

lines.zh: 披风被风吹起，露了破绽。
lines.en: The wind lifts your cloak and shows a gap.

lines.zh: 再挪一寸，就出掩体了。
lines.en: One more inch and you leave cover.

lines.zh: 樱桃核已经在喉咙口。
lines.en: The cherry pit is already at my throat.

lines.zh: 贴这么近，那就炸给你看。
lines.en: This close? Then I burst in your face.

lines.zh: 壳撞壳，看谁先裂。
lines.en: Shell against shell; see who cracks first.

lines.zh: 没有距离，我就用牙。
lines.en: No distance left, so I use my teeth.

lines.zh: 魔法弹贴脸引爆，别怪我。
lines.en: Point-blank magic burst; do not blame me.

lines.zh: 这一下酸得你睁不开眼。
lines.en: This one will sour your eyes shut.

lines.zh: 退！我身上全是碎糖。
lines.en: Back off! I am covered in sugar shards.

lines.zh: 你抓住了樱桃梗，松手。
lines.en: You grabbed my stem; let go.

lines.zh: 近身不是强项，但够用。
lines.en: Close quarters is not my strength, but it serves.

lines.zh: 糖浆溅你一脸，活该。
lines.en: Syrup splashed your face; you earned it.

lines.zh: 裂开的壳照样能撞。
lines.en: A cracked shell still hits hard.

lines.zh: 从糖果土里钻出来，壳上沾着糖霜。
lines.en: Out of the candy soil, frosting still on my shell.

lines.zh: 这地方的颜色太甜，我不习惯。
lines.en: The colors here are too sweet; I am unused to them.

lines.zh: 樱桃熟了的季节，我就醒了。
lines.en: I wake when the cherries ripen.

lines.zh: 糖果维度的风，吹得壳发凉。
lines.en: The candy dimension's wind cools my shell.

lines.zh: 先找一棵糖果树，站到树荫下。
lines.en: First find a candy tree and stand in its shade.

lines.zh: 谁把我种在这儿的？不管了。
lines.en: Who planted me here? Never mind.

lines.zh: 我闻到酸味，附近有同类。
lines.en: I smell sourness; kin must be nearby.

lines.zh: 刚睁眼，射程还没校准。
lines.en: Just opened my eyes; range is not calibrated.

lines.zh: 糖浆河在响，水是甜的。
lines.en: The syrup river murmurs; its water is sweet.

lines.zh: 这身红壳太显眼，得躲一躲。
lines.en: This red shell stands out; I should hide.

lines.zh: 土里还有别的核，别踩。
lines.en: Other pits sleep in this soil; do not tread.

lines.zh: 我数了数，这里能退七步。
lines.en: I counted: seven steps of retreat here.

lines.zh: 第一件事，是把准星调正。
lines.en: First thing: true up my sights.

lines.zh: 樱桃炸弹落地，从不打招呼。
lines.en: A cherry blaster lands without a greeting.

lines.zh: 糖壳遇火就化，别烧我。
lines.en: Sugar shells melt in fire; do not burn me.

lines.zh: 摔下来，裂口又宽了一寸。
lines.en: I fell, and the crack widened an inch.

lines.zh: 糖浆灌进缝里，动不了了。
lines.en: Syrup pours into my seams; I cannot move.

lines.zh: 整片糖地都被掀起来了。
lines.en: The whole candy field got flipped up.

lines.zh: 箭插在壳上，像根签子。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my shell like a skewer.

lines.zh: 同类的魔法？味道不对。
lines.en: Kin magic? The taste is wrong.

lines.zh: 糖分不够，魔法转得慢了。
lines.en: Not enough sugar; my magic turns slowly.

lines.zh: 雷打在糖树上，也烧到了我。
lines.en: Lightning struck the candy tree and burned me too.

lines.zh: 掉进虚空，连糖渣都没剩。
lines.en: Into the void, not even sugar crumbs remain.
